name: ExaUser-Images
description: Exa's user-triggered image fetcher, the image counterpart of ExaUser. It retrieves an image live when a person, or an application built on the Exa API, asks for it. The operator documents it as separate from ExaSearchBot-Images: it does no scheduled or background crawling, it is not used to decide whether content appears in Exa search, and each fetch is a single GET for the image URL with the image reduced to at most 560 pixels on its longest side before it is returned. Requests are signed with Web Bot Auth.
